schema: The public article supplement is a 4-page PDF with Figures S1-S3 and Supplemental Table 1 HLA genotypes; it contains no peptide-level immunopeptidome table. Article states no public repository accession; datasets are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request while deposition is prepared.
stimulus_and_timing: HNA and donor fibroblast conditions compared after vehicle or IFNγ 100 ng/mL for 72 h; 120-200 million cells per condition are described for immunopeptidomics. The authors note deep-coverage peptide datasets were not generated for all experimental conditions.
units_and_counts: Four human donors in the deep immunopeptidomic comparisons; the same-donor cross-laboratory replication is not an independent donor. Separate snRNA-seq time course has 8 time×treatment conditions and 96,229 nuclei, but cell count is not independent biological-unit count.
join_keys: Public peptide sequence-to-donor/condition rows, HLA-level rows and MS limits are not available; HLA haplotypes are in the supplement, but no ligand table or peptide sample keys.
paired_controls: Vehicle and IFNγ comparisons plus matched fibroblast controls are described in the paper; exact peptide-level paired records cannot be inspected.
measured_vs_derived: HLA peptide detections by IP-LC-MS/MS are measured; HLA binding/allotype and neuron-source classifications are predicted or derived. CEF T-cell recognition uses forced exogenous viral epitopes; NEFL responses use protein-pulsed APCs, not proof that endogenous neural NEFL peptides caused injury.
limits: Positive direct MS detection could challenge cancer restriction, but nondetection cannot establish safety. No sequence rows means no exact join to a cancer-target list or held-out state-aware evaluation. No author contact or data-request made.; targeted exact-DOI searches of official PRIDE and MassIVE records found no indexed entry; this does not prove no deposit exists elsewhere

schema: Data 2 cleanpep 785x13 incl header; 784 unique peptide rows. Data 7 20230910_heatmap_10clusters 293x21 incl header; 292 unique peptide strings, 10 clusters, first 16 columns meaningful. Full details in P05_data_inspection.md.
stimulus_and_timing: ECN90 basal vs IFNα 2000 U/mL 18 h; Data 2 fractions 0/4 through 4/4; Data 7 flags Basal, CAR, IFNα, IFNα+CAR, IFNα+ONX.
units_and_counts: Four preparations from one line, not independent donors. Data 7 lacks sample/replicate IDs; two primary islet preparations are untreated-only and not paired.
join_keys: Exact peptide-string comparison of 784 Data 2 values vs 74 JCI Table 5 peptide sequences: 0 matches. No sample/donor cross-study keys. PTM notation retained, no normalization.
paired_controls: Basal vs IFNα study-level contrast; Data 2 has only fractions, not named replicate rows. Data 7 has table-level Y/N condition flags without replicate pairs.
measured_vs_derived: MS peptide detections and Data 2 fractions are observed measurements; Data 7 flags summarize detections. HLA restriction/rank predicted; clusters and source-protein annotations derived.
limits: Two official public workbooks downloaded after 200/size checks: 85,288 and 37,674 bytes (122,962 total; each below 25 MiB and total below 75 MiB). Data 2 is selected, not exhaustive. Data 7 is an author-clustered published contrast without replicate keys. Zero overlap is not nonpresentation or safety; no novel fixed contrast/pilot passed.
